relationships.subject: [Ala13]-apelin-13
relationships.evidence_quote: Intraperitoneal (ip) administration of [Ala13]-apelin-13, an APJ antagonist, blocked lipopolysaccharide (LPS)- or CRF-induced visceral hypersensitivity and colonic hyperpermeability (IBS model) in a dose-response manner.

relationships.subject: [Pyr1]-apelin-13
relationships.evidence_quote: On the other hand, ip [Pyr1]-apelin-13, an APJ agonist, caused visceral hypersensitivity and colonic hyperpermeability

relationships.subject: TAK-242
relationships.evidence_quote: these effects were reversed by astressin, a CRF receptor antagonist, TAK-242, a TLR4 antagonist or anakinra, an interleukin-1 receptor antagonist

relationships.subject: APJ
relationships.evidence_quote: APJ system modulated CRF-TLR4-proinflammatory cytokine signaling to cause visceral hypersensitivity and colonic hyperpermeability.

key_findings: APJ agonist causes visceral hypersensitivity and hyperpermeability, reversed by TLR4 antagonist TAK-242
